mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, addr_name, addr_person_name, addr_person_mobile, img, imges, status, create_time, update_time, wx_mchid, wxapiv2_private_key, shou_ye, huo_dong, chong_zhi, new_recharge_day, new_recharge_money, new_recharge_awards FROM bluetooth_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status != '删除'

SELECT id, user_id, addr_name, addr_person_name, addr_person_mobile, img, imges, status, create_time, update_time, wx_mchid, wxapiv2_private_key, shou_ye, huo_dong, chong_zhi, new_recharge_day, new_recharge_money, new_recharge_awards FROM bluetooth_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND addr_name = #{addrName} AND status != '删除' LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, addr_name, addr_person_name, addr_person_mobile, img, imges, status, create_time, update_time, wx_mchid, wxapiv2_private_key, shou_ye, huo_dong, chong_zhi, new_recharge_day, new_recharge_money, new_recharge_awards FROM bluetooth_address WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bluetooth_address ( user_id, addr_name, addr_person_name, addr_person_mobile, img, imges, status, create_time, update_time, wx_mchid, wxapiv2_private_key, shou_ye, huo_dong, chong_zhi, new_recharge_day, new_recharge_money, new_recharge_awards) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{addrName}, #{addrPersonName}, #{addrPersonMobile}, #{img}, #{imges}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{wxMchid}, #{wxapiv2PrivateKey}, #{shouYe}, #{huoDong}, #{chongZhi}, #{newRechargeDay}, #{newRechargeMoney}, #{newRechargeAwards})
mapper.select: SELECT id as addressId, addr_name AS name, short_name AS shortName FROM `bluetooth_address` WHERE status = '正常'
